# Introduction

This document describes how to use AlphaSimR to model
genotype-by-environment interaction.

```{r, eval=FALSE}

# Legacy GxE trait
SP$addTraitAG(nQtlPerChr=100, mean=0, var=1, varGxE=1, legacyGxE=TRUE)

# New GxE trait
SP$addTraitAG(nQtlPerChr=100, mean=0, var=1, varGxL=1, varGxL_Y=1)
  
SP$setVarE(H2=0.5, useGxE=TRUE)

# Legacy GxE
p = runif(40)
year = 1
pop = setPheno(pop, p=p[year], reps=2, fixEff=year)

# New GxE trait
year = 1
pop = setPheno(pop, year=year, reps=1, locs=2)

PYT = setPheno(PYT, year=year, fixEff=paste0("PYT_", year))

pheno_df = setPheno(PYT, year=year, fixEff=paste0("PYT_", year), returnPheno=TRUE)


```
